narrative: Flowise 3.1.0's June 6 fix shipped an allowlist-and-flag-validation guard as a default restriction on its tool-execution path, and Obsidian Security pushed an even harder default (drop stdio for SSE). That is maintainers moving toward least-privilege-by-default rather than opt-in hardening - the predicted direction-of-travel - though the control is broad MCP execution, not a read-only SQL default.
remaining_gap: Evidence is one MCP-adapter fix, not the specific SELECT-only SQL default, and far short of three text-to-SQL frameworks shipping safe-by-default.
